jobs.title: Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title:

Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio

NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life

CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change

The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.

About The Digital Innovation Office (DIO)

The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof-of-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI-enabled future.

In addition, the candidate will participate in user-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.

Main Duties And Responsibilities
2. Sandbox Platform Management

Technical Prototype Engineering
Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and workflow components.
Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms , and architecture diagrams.
Provide hands-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.
Maintain DIS multi-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
Administrative support
Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
Design and deliver hands-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud-based tools and platforms.

Job Requirements

EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
5 years hands-on engineering experience (front-end or back-end in cloud environment).
Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low-code/no-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.
Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation

Desired Skills

Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Keywords Studios, established in Dublin in 1998, now has 70+ studios across Europe, North and South America and Asia with 12,000+ employee strength located across 5 continents and 26 countries. The company provides complete outsourced game art, engineering, testing, audio and localization service for all Console, PC, Handheld and Mobile content, to many of the biggest names in games and interactive entertainment, working on thousands of titles including many of the best-selling titles of the past few years.

Keywords Studios is comprised of many individual brands, all with something unique to offer our clients. The studios are integrated into the Group by Service Line and use the operating systems and tools deployed by those services lines to ensure people and projects can operate across studios and across geographies.

Keywords Studios Asia is currently hiring for Singapore based Software Engineers.

Requirements

We are looking for enthusiastic and self-motivated Software Engineers to join our Singapore-based team, working on an exciting, new, and unannounced AAA project.

This is a generalist engineering role with a strong focus on providing front-line technical support to developers. You will investigate development issues, help unblock teams, apply corrective measures where appropriate, and ensure problems are directed to the relevant system owners when deeper investigation is required.

We are hiring across mid and senior levels, with responsibilities calibrated based on experience.

Responsibilities:

Investigate technical issues reported by developers and perform initial analysis to identify the likely cause
Apply corrective measures where appropriate, including fixing or rolling back broken compilation or build issues
Provide operational guidance to developers to help unblock their work, for example directing them to a stable or usable build
Escalate and route issues or JIRAs to the appropriate system owners when further specialist investigation is required
Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to support development and maintain a high-quality product
Test, debug, and refine systems and features throughout the development cycle
Estimate own tasks and deliver high-quality code according to agreed schedules
Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and development standards

Requirements:

Professional software engineering experience in games or related real-time interactive development
Strong proficiency in C++ and C# knowledge.
Good familiarity with large C++ game codebases
Experience working with Perforce or similar source-control systems
Experience with commercial game engines such as Unreal Engine and/or Unity
Strong debugging, investigation, and problem-solving skills
Comfortable analysing unfamiliar technical issues and helping developers find practical ways to continue working
Comfortable working with distributed teams across different locations and collaborating clearly across disciplines
Experience contributing to at least one shipped game in a professional capacity

Nice to have:

Previous experience in a generalist engineering, developer support, build support, or firefighting role
Knowledge of industry-standard development practices including source control, asset pipelines, issue tracking, external QA, and localisation
Experience with continuous integration and build automation
Exposure to post-launch product development and delivery
Experience working in an Agile development environment
Experience with art packages and pipeline development
Experience with low-level optimisation, shader programming, physics, or mathematics

Benefits

Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice .

jobs.title: Software Engineer, BizSG
jobs.description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

As a Software Engineer (II) at GovTech, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining innovative digital solutions that enhance public service delivery for citizens and businesses in Singapore. You will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, working within agile teams to build robust, scalable, and secure applications.

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software applications and systems across various platforms.
Collaborate with product managers, UX/UI designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following established coding standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring code quality.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and issues in a timely manner.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of software development processes and tools.
Keep abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their applicability to GovTech's initiatives.
Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge within the team.
Ensure the security, reliability, and performance of developed applications.

[What are we looking for]

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
2-4 years of experience in software development.
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Java, Python, Go, C#, or JavaScript.
Experience with front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue.js) and/or back-end frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Node.js).
Familiarity with database technologies (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
Understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum).
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).
Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.
Strong problem-solving skills and a keen eye for detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. 

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

jobs.title: Senior Softwareentwickler/-in .NET/C# (80-100%)
jobs.description:
M&S Software Engineering entwickelt seit über 35 Jahren Softwarelösungen für Ausgleichs- und Pensionskassen in der Schweiz. Mit rund 200 Mitarbeitenden in Bern (Wankdorf) und Schlieren (ZH) prägen wir die Zukunft der Sozialversicherungen mit. Durch unsere Arbeit leisten wir einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zur sozialen Vorsorge der Schweizer Bevölkerung.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur basiert auf Teamgeist, Respekt und Wertschätzung. Als Arbeitgeber wurden wir mehrfach ausgezeichnet, unter anderem von Great Place to Work und kununu.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst und wartest komplexe Fachanwendungen für MSPension, unsere Branchenlösung für die berufliche Vorsorge, auf Basis von .NET/C# und Microsoft SQL Server.

Du unterstützt Lösungsarchitektur und Projektleitung vom Lösungskonzept bis zur Abnahme. Nach der Einarbeitung prägst du die technischen Lösungen mit.

Du arbeitest in einem festen, reinen Entwicklungsteam von acht Personen nach Scrum, meist an mehreren Erweiterungsprojekten parallel.

Bei technisch anspruchsvollen Kundenfällen hilfst du im 3rd-Level-Support mit. Pikettdienst gibt es in der Entwicklung nicht.

Nebst der Entwicklung schreibst du automatisierte Tests und leistest mit Code-Reviews und Pair-Programming einen wichtigen Beitrag an unsere Softwarequalität.

Qualifikation

Du hast langjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit .NET/C#, und findest dich in gewachsenem Code zurecht.

Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit Microsoft SQL Server, inklusive Performanceanalyse und Optimierung komplexer Abfragen.

Du gehst gerne in die Tiefe und willst dir Expertise für ein komplexes Fachsystem aufbauen.

Du arbeitest präzise und bringst Ausdauer für die Fachlichkeit mit. Bei uns wird aus Gesetzestext Logik. Das BVG-Wissen dazu baust du bei uns laufend auf.

Ein Studium oder eine HF-Ausbildung ist von Vorteil, entscheidend ist deine Erfahrung.

Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, Englisch für Dokumentation und gelegentliche Gespräche.

Benefits

Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen:
bis zu zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche, Teilzeitarbeit, Förderung von Gesundheit und Sozialem, Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg, etc.

Grosszügige Fringe Benefits:
Kostenbeteiligungen (persönliche IT-/Homeoffice-Infrastruktur, Handy-Abo, Verpflegung, ÖV/Parkplatz, Sport-/Fitnessabo), Dienstaltersgeschenk, etc.

Bildung und Karriere:
professionelle Einführung, Förderung betrieblicher und persönlicher Weiterbildung, Entwicklung Richtung Fachverantwortung, etc.

Gestalte mit M&S die digitale Zukunft der Sozialversicherungen mit! Ein tolles Team und ein moderner Arbeitsplatz in Bern-Wankdorf erwarten dich. Bewirb dich jetzt!

jobs.title: Software Engineer (C#) ID90603
jobs.description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a C# Developer
to contribute to the development and maintenance of an application-protection product built on C# and IL. This person works alongside two senior engineers on implementation and problem-solving, building familiarity with obfuscation and runtime protection. Comfort supervising AI-assisted development and verifying results is part of the role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Contribute to development and maintenance of a C# and IL-focused application-protection product.
- Work alongside two senior engineers to implement product changes and solve technical problems.
- Build understanding of the product's obfuscation and runtime-protection context, including its interaction with customer application builds.
- Break down implementation tasks and seek clarification from teammates when requirements or technical approaches are unclear.
- Use Claude Code in daily development while retaining responsibility for reviewing and verifying the resulting implementation.
- Contribute to adjacent technical tasks when required, using investigation, collaboration, and AI assistance to work beyond the primary stack.

MUST HAVES

- Hands-on C# software engineering skills at a mid-level proficiency, of at least 3 years
.
- Ability to work collaboratively with senior engineers on product implementation and technical problem-solving.
- Critical thinking: break problems into clear steps, identify gaps in understanding, and ask useful questions of teammates and AI agents.
- Ability to supervise AI-assisted development, review generated code, and verify that implementations achieve the intended result.
- Willingness to learn and contribute outside the primary stack, including C++ packages, front-end tasks, and CI/CD
, when needed.
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

- Familiarity with .NET Intermediate Language (IL) and how C# applications are built and executed.
- Experience with code obfuscation, runtime protection, or application-security tooling.
- Experience with command-line tools and build-process integrations.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

- Professional growth
: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation
: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects
: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime
: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.
